summary: Independently verified TEMA Middleware Phase 1.5. All 10 requested checks pass: build, lint, 23 unit tests, 15 e2e tests, OpenAPI export (paths exactly /health,/ready,/version), Swagger off-by-default in production (GET /docs-json => 404), Swagger explicitly enabled returns openapi 3.0.0 with only the 3 current paths, correlation ID auto-generated when absent and propagated when provided (TEST-123 echoed in x-correlation-id header AND appears as correlationId=TEST-123 with durationMs in structured log), and unknown routes return consistent {code,message,requestId} JSON with no stack traces. /health returns {status:UP,service:tema-middleware}, /ready returns status READY, /version returns version 0.1.0.
critical_code_review_comments: Error filter correctly redacts internal details; verified via unit test 'secret db connection string leaked' scenario returns generic message.
AsyncLocalStorage-based correlation context is properly wired; propagation confirmed end-to-end.
resolveSwaggerEnabled behaves correctly: off in production unless SWAGGER_ENABLED=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Standalone Node/NestJS app at /app/tema-middleware/. Not part of supervisor stack. Start manually with `node dist/main.js` on a free port; remember to kill background processes. yarn scripts: build, lint, test, test:e2e, openapi:generate. openapi.json must contain ONLY /health,/ready,/version paths.
